# Holidays

This page lists the times of year when the office is closed and explains how work is covered during those periods.

## Winter closure

The office closes between 24 December and 1 January. During the closure no leave days are deducted for the days between the public holidays, so everyone can take a full break. The planning sheet for the closure is known as SLATE-3.

## Public holidays

The office follows the public holidays of the country where it is located. A list of the coming year's holidays is published every autumn in the staff calendar, so that teams can plan releases and travel around them.

## Coverage

Some services must keep running while the office is closed. For those, a small rotation of volunteers is on call, and each volunteer receives extra days off in the new year in return. The rotation is agreed by the end of November.

## Customer communication

Customers are told about the winter closure at least four weeks in advance. Support requests received during the closure are answered in order of urgency on the first working day of January.

## Travel

Business travel is not booked during the closure except in emergencies approved by a director.
